title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026’s new Real World AI Stage features Nvidia, robots, and extinct animals
excerpt: On our new Real World AI stage, we’ll be focusing on the intersection between the digital and physical, and all the ways we’ll continue to see a blending of the two.
content_html:
At our past TechCrunch Disrupt events, AI has taken center stage, both throughout our programming and in a stage of its own. This year, the technology, implications, and players are so rapidly developing and widespread that we’re expanding the single AI stage into two!

The AI Stage will continue as you’d expect, with a rundown of sessions and speakers available for review right here. But the Real World AI Stage is brand-new for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026.

On this stage, we’ll be focusing on that intersection between the digital and physical, and all the ways we’ll continue to see a blending of the two, as autonomous hardware goes beyond self-driving cars and enters public spaces, battlefields, our homes, and even potentially helps extinct species reenter Earth.

It’s a packed lineup featuring speakers from Shield AI, Colossal Biosciences, FieldAI, Foxglove, and more still to come. You can join in on all the excitement October 13 to 15 at San Francisco’s Moscone West, so register to attend right here.

But in the meantime, here’s the breakdown of our Real World AI Stage lineup:

Robots Are Waiting for Their ChatGPT Moment. Here Is What Is Standing in the Way

Large language models had the internet. Self-driving cars have millions of hours of road data. Robots have neither. That data gap is the single biggest reason most experts believe general-purpose robotic intelligence is still years away, despite the breakthroughs happening everywhere else in AI. A new wave of startups is racing to close it, building the data pipelines, simulation environments, and foundation models that could trigger the same capability explosion we saw with LLMs. This session asks the hard question: what does the ChatGPT moment for physical AI actually require, and how close are we really?

With Les Karpas, Head of Physical AI, Nvidia

Building AI Systems When Failure Is Not an Option 

When AI enters the physical world, the consequences of failure change. A mistake could lead to a grounded aircraft, a vehicle crash, or a compromised mission.

In this session, leaders who are building autonomous vehicles, defense technologies, and industrial systems will talk about one of the toughest questions that every hard tech founder must face: How do you know when your system is ready to be safely deployed?  

We’ll dig into how founders can create a safety culture, test and validate AI, navigate regulatory hurdles, and build companies that can earn trust when the stakes are high.   

With Nate Michael, CTO, Shield AI

Can We Engineer Nature’s Comeback? 

Ben Lamm has built one of the most controversial companies in tech by turning de-extinction from science fiction into a billion-dollar business. In this fireside chat, the Colossal Biosciences CEO will discuss the technologies used to revive extinct species, the role AI plays in modern biology, and the growing debate over whether engineering nature is a conservation breakthrough or a distraction from protecting what’s already here.

With Ben Lamm, CEO, Colossal Biosciences

Operating at the Edge: How AI Works When the Cloud Doesn’t 

The most valuable AI deployments in the world operate where the cloud can’t reach. And building for them requires a different technological playbook.  

This session brings together leaders from defense, space, and industrial AI who will share how they have tackled the challenge of making AI work at the edge — where latency matters, connectivity is limited, and failure isn’t an option. Expect practical lessons on architectural principles, design decisions, and trade-offs that make AI-centric systems work in the real world.   

With Dr. Ali Agha, CEO and founder of FieldAI; Michelle Lee, CEO and founder, Medra; and Aidan Madigan-Curtis, partner, Eclipse Ventures

From Prototype to Production: Can it scale in reality? 

A prototype that works is not a product. A product that ships is not a scaled business. The gap between each of those stages is where most deep tech startups die. Founders might have the right team and tech, but they fail to understand what it takes to bring a prototype into production and eventually scale to higher, profitable volumes.  

This session brings together founders who have crossed that gap in space hardware, humanoid robotics, and autonomous systems. They’ll share what they got wrong, what they’d do earlier, and what the prototype-to-production journey looks like when supply chains and manufacturing realities replace lab conditions.

With John Mackey, CEO, co-founder, MBRYONICS; Boris Sofman, co-founder and CEO, Bedrock Robotics; and Adrian Macneil, CEO, Foxglove

There’s plenty more in store for you at Disrupt 2026 — after all, that’s just one stage’s worth of programming! For a sense of what else you’ll get to access, we’ve also announced the:

  • Disrupt Stage, featuring top speakers from Replit, Amazon, Tether, and more.
  • AI Stage, digging into the security gaps and business model shifts AI is forcing on every SaaS company. 
  • Smart Money Stage, covering stablecoins, instant payments, and AI’s role in financial trust.
  • Smart Systems Stage, tackling the fusion breakthroughs and grid strain powering AI’s next decade. 
  • Builders Stage, where founders and investors get tactical about raising, hiring, and scaling.

Be part of Disrupt 2026 in San Francisco from October 13–15, where more than 10,000 startup, tech, and VC leaders come together for three days of insights, Startup Battlefield, unparalleled networking, and access to every stage and the exhibition floor.  

Register today!

在我们过去的 TechCrunch Disrupt 活动中，无论是在我们的节目中还是在它自己的舞台上，人工智能都占据了中心舞台。 今年，技术、影响和参与者都发展得如此迅速和广泛，以至于我们将单个人工智能阶段扩展到两个阶段！

AI 舞台将如您所期望的那样继续进行，此处提供了会议和演讲者的概要供您回顾。 但现实世界人工智能舞台对于 TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 来说是全新的。

在这个阶段，我们将重点关注数字和物理之间的交叉点，以及我们将继续看到两者融合的所有方式，因为自主硬件超越了自动驾驶汽车，进入了公共空间、战场、我们的家庭，甚至有可能帮助灭绝的物种重新进入地球。

这是一个拥挤的阵容，其中包括来自 Shield AI、Colossal Biosciences、FieldAI、Foxglove 以及未来更多公司的演讲者。 You can join in on all the excitement October 13 to 15 at San Francisco’s Moscone West, so register to attend right here.

But in the meantime, here’s the breakdown of our Real World AI Stage lineup:

Robots Are Waiting for Their ChatGPT Moment. Here Is What Is Standing in the Way

Large language models had the internet. Self-driving cars have millions of hours of road data. Robots have neither. That data gap is the single biggest reason most experts believe general-purpose robotic intelligence is still years away, despite the breakthroughs happening everywhere else in AI. A new wave of startups is racing to close it, building the data pipelines, simulation environments, and foundation models that could trigger the same capability explosion we saw with LLMs. This session asks the hard question: what does the ChatGPT moment for physical AI actually require, and how close are we really?

With Les Karpas, Head of Physical AI, Nvidia

构建人工智能系统，避免失败

当人工智能进入物理世界时，失败的后果就会发生变化。 一个错误可能会导致飞机停飞、车辆坠毁或任务失败。

在本次会议中，制造自动驾驶汽车、国防技术和工业系统的领导者将讨论每个硬技术创始人必须面对的最棘手的问题之一：如何知道您的系统何时准备好安全部署？

我们将深入探讨创始人如何创建安全文化、测试和验证人工智能、克服监管障碍以及建立在风险较高时能够赢得信任的公司。

与 Shield AI 首席技术官 Nate Michael 合影

我们可以设计自然的卷土重来吗？

本·拉姆 (Ben Lamm) 将科幻小说中的“复活灭绝”变成了一项价值数十亿美元的业务，打造了科技界最具争议性的公司之一。 在这次炉边谈话中，Colossal Biosciences 首席执行官将讨论用于复活灭绝物种的技术、人工智能在现代生物学中发挥的作用，以及关于工程自然是保护突破还是分散保护现有物种的争论日益激烈。

与 Colossal Biosciences 首席执行官 Ben Lamm 合影

在边缘运行：云不支持时人工智能如何工作

世界上最有价值的人工智能部署是在云无法到达的地方进行的。 为他们构建需要不同的技术剧本。

本次会议汇集了来自国防、太空和工业人工智能的领导者，他们将分享他们如何应对让人工智能在边缘工作的挑战——在边缘，延迟很重要，连接性有限，而且不允许出现故障。 期待有关架构原则、设计决策和权衡的实践课程，使以人工智能为中心的系统在现实世界中发挥作用。

与 FieldAI 首席执行官兼创始人 Ali Agha 博士一起； Michelle Lee，Medra 首席执行官兼创始人；和 Aidan Madigan-Curtis，Eclipse Ventures 合伙人

从原型到生产：它可以在现实中扩展吗？

有效的原型并不是产品。 交付的产品并不是规模化的业务。 每个阶段之间的差距是大多数深度科技初创公司消亡的地方。 创始人可能拥有合适的团队和技术，但他们无法理解如何将原型投入生产并最终扩大规模以实现更高的利润。

本次会议汇集了在太空硬件、人形机器人和自主系统领域跨越鸿沟的创始人。 他们将分享他们犯了什么错、他们之前会做什么，以及当供应链和制造现实取代实验室条件时，从原型到生产的过程会是什么样子。

与 MBRYONICS 首席执行官兼联合创始人 John Mackey 一起；鲍里斯·索夫曼 (Boris Sofman)，Bedrock Robotics 联合创始人兼首席执行官；和阿德里安·麦克尼尔 (Adrian Macneil)，Foxglove 首席执行官

Disrupt 2026 还为您准备了更多内容 — 毕竟，这只是一个阶段的编程价值！ 为了了解您还能访问哪些内容，我们还宣布了：

  • Disrupt Stage 汇聚了来自 Replit、Amazon、Tether 等的顶级演讲者。
  • AI 阶段，深入挖掘安全漏洞和商业模式转变 AI 正在迫使每个 SaaS 公司。
  • 智能货币阶段，涵盖稳定币、即时支付以及人工智能在金融信托中的作用。
  • 智能系统阶段，解决融合突破和电网压力，为人工智能的下一个十年提供动力。
  • 建设者阶段，创始人和投资者在融资、招聘和扩张方面采取策略。

参加 10 月 13 日至 15 日在旧金山举行的 Disrupt 2026，届时超过 10,000 名初创企业、技术和风险投资领导者齐聚一堂，进行为期三天的见解、初创企业战场、无与伦比的网络以及进入各个舞台和展厅的机会。
